caption: The drawing depicts an ornate handheld eyeglass, commonly referred to as a lorgnette. The handle is long and intricately designed with curling, decorative elements, resembling entwined vines or ornamental filigree; it is predominantly brown with some greenish and yellowish hues to suggest shading and metallic or wooden texture. Attached at the top of the handle is a pair of round spectacles, with thin, gold or brass-colored frames and light blue-tinted lenses. The entire object is centered on a plain, off-white or beige background with no other objects or visible features.
title: Tortoise Shell Lorgnette
